question: Does the exploratory two-symbol receiver toggle recur on fresh source distances, and does its timing survive a changed waiting gap?

exploratory_origin.old_milestone_status: failed: only two distinct symbols and second event outside fixed20..21window

preparation.sources: Source 1 at origin+(-d1,0,0), source 2 at origin+(d2,0,0); each g0=(0,1,2), g14=(0,-1,2).
preparation.armed_guide: Strictly between source endpoints, g0=(0,0,4), g14=(0,0,0), other channels background. Source endpoints use their own triples.
preparation.detector: Origin channels 0 and 14; initial remainder pair (4,0), counters zero.
preparation.no_source_removal: Set only source a,b to zero; keep all remainders and apparatus identical.
preparation.boundary_margin: At least 72 > 40, excluding periodic wrap influence in this horizon.

fixed_observers.R: Every change M(t)!=M(t-1), t>=1; the initial symbol is not an event.
fixed_observers.C_channel: Unchanged existing guard: ell!=0 and full triple changed; kind=u mod 3.
fixed_observers.C_bank: At least one authentic detector C event in an update; retain all individual coincident channel events.
fixed_observers.external_count: N(t)=sum C_bank is a passive history functional, not an added internal counter.

predictions.status: Preregistered empirical timing hypothesis inferred from endpoint-064; not an established timing theorem. All three fresh cases are retained regardless of outcome.
predictions.phase_aligned_family: Gaps8and12, pairs(16,24),(16,28), are the nominal phase-aligned generalization.
predictions.phase_challenge: Gap10, pair(16,26), prospectively tests a changed counter phase. Its failure rejects the broader phase-independent claim and is not discarded from the report.
predictions.neither: No detector R or C in the entire horizon; whole board stationary.
predictions.source1_only: Exactly one R and one coincident C-bearing update at t=d1; M0=(4,0) then M1=(0,4), retained through 40.
predictions.source2_only: Exactly one R and one coincident C-bearing update at t=d2; M0 then M1, retained through 40.
predictions.both: Exactly two R changes and C-bearing updates at t=d1 and d2+2; M0 -> M1 -> M0, with no further detector R or C through 40.
predictions.record_scope: The final local bit equals its initial value. It is an alternating record/clock phase, not a local counter retaining the two-event history.

acceptance.per_case: All four controls meet their fixed predictions, incident input and source counterfactual checks, quiet intervals and complete-state verification.
acceptance.nominal_family: Both gap-8 and gap-12 cases pass; report each case and all failed checks.
acceptance.phase_independent_extension: All three cases pass, including gap 10. No result from gap 10 can be reclassified after observation.
acceptance.quiet_updates: Exact old-state indices [d1-4,d1-2], [d1,d1+3], and [d2+2,d2+5] in the both-source run: both detector net inputs must be zero. Single-source pre/post windows center on its own fixed tick. Every other R/C in the horizon is still counted.
acceptance.actual_event_input: Each predicted C/R update t requires at least one nonzero net u at old state t-1 and an input vector different from the corresponding source-absent control.
acceptance.incoming_source_disturbance: For source 2, compare all six signed input terms at old state d2-1 between both-source and source-1-only, and save the earliest difference. A zero net sum does not prove the absence of an arriving disturbance.
acceptance.latency_interpretation: Report separately the first causal input-vector change, the first nonzero net sum, and C/R time. Call their separation a latency only if the actual input terms establish those distinct events; the timing hypothesis alone is insufficient.

budget.stop: Resource exhaustion is inconclusive; retain completed cases and the stop reason.

presentation.label: Fresh two-symbol toggle confirmation; independent of failed three-symbol milestone.
